subject: Program stipend packaging and onboarding grace period?
messages:
From: Megan Cho <megan@aerolaunch.io>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Startup stipend packaging question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency profiles. We're lining up the paperwork for the summer cohort and I need a quick clarification about how Redwood structures the program stipend and the onboarding billing timeline. Specific items: 

- Does the stipend appear as a single prepaid credit on the invoice or as a monthly amortized line?
- If we don't hit consumption in month one, is there any automatic rollover or a short grace period before billing starts?
- Are promotional add-ons (e.g., model fine-tuning credits) bundled with the stipend or treated as separate SKUs?

We have an internal procurement cadence that prefers an upfront PO and a 60-day grace before consumption charges kick in; curious whether that's feasible. I've attached our PO template for reference (PO_1234.pdf).

Appreciate the clarity,
Megan Cho
Head of Developer Programs
AeroLaunch Labs

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Megan Cho <megan@aerolaunch.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup stipend packaging question

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben from Partnerships for a quick pricing take.

Short answers up front:
- Stipend presentation: we can do either a single prepaid credit (recommended for simpler bookkeeping) or an amortized monthly credit line — both are supported.
- Grace period: standard program terms include a 30-day activation window. We can approve a one-time extension to 60 days for cohort exceptions; longer windows require leadership approval.
- Add-ons: promotional fine-tuning credits are usually a separate SKU so usage and reporting stay distinct, but we can bundle them on the invoice if you need a single-line item.

Options we suggest (attached: Stipend_Terms_v2.pdf and a compact pricing matrix):
A) Prepaid stipend on one invoice + 30-day activation window (standard)
B) Prepaid stipend + 60-day onboarding grace (one-time exception; needs sign-off)
C) Amortized stipend across 3 months + bundled add-ons (custom invoice line items)

If procurement prefers an upfront PO and 60 days before usage billing, option B maps cleanly — we just need an internal approval note. Ben, can you confirm whether Partnerships can approve a 60-day exception for a new cohort?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Accelerator Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Megan Cho <megan@aerolaunch.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup stipend packaging question

Thanks for the breakdown, Soojin. I'm fine moving forward with option B for AeroLaunch as a cohort special — it helps close the pilot and their procurement timeline. A couple of clarifications and a proposed mutual action plan: 

- Conditions for 60-day onboarding grace (brief):
  * PO signed and received (we'll apply the prepaid stipend against that PO)
  * AeroLaunch confirms a single billing contact and agrees to the trial acceptance criteria in the attached matrix
  * Usage caps remain in place; overages bill monthly after the grace period unless otherwise negotiated

- MAP (mutual action plan):
  1) AeroLaunch signs PO (they sent PO_1234.pdf).
  2) Redwood issues a single prepaid credit invoice with "Program Stipend - AeroLaunch Cohort" and notes the 60-day activation window.
  3) AeroLaunch activates the account; Redwood provides onboarding support and a usage report at day 45.
  4) If consumption is below the minimum threshold by day 60, Partnerships will work a 30-day extension or apply a reduced invoiced amount for the consumed tokens — we should capture this as an exception in the contract addendum.

Lauren — can you approve the one-off exception to standard 30-day activation for this deal (DL-2027-089)? If yes I'll draft the addendum and the invoice language.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_matrix.xlsx

On the exception: approved with conditions.

Approve: 60-day onboarding grace for AeroLaunch Labs for deal DL-2027-089, with the following guardrails:
- This is a one-time cohort exception, not a program-wide policy change.
- PO must be received and escrowed as prepaid credit.
- Redwood will issue an invoiced credit line titled exactly: "Program Stipend - AeroLaunch Cohort (DL-2027-089)" and track stipend usage separately from any fine-tuning credits.

Ben — please attach the addendum draft and the DocuSign link. Megan — we'll send the single-line invoice and DocuSign today; expect a HubSpot deal note and a signed addendum to finalize.
